title: Do Not Strike the Slime
story: In the flooded lower mines of Gorrowpit, an ooze triples in number every single time a blade touches it. The last knight struck it four times and had to run. Mr 6 stands ankle-deep in green water and decides to count instead of swing.
question: If there is 1 ooze now and every strike makes each ooze become 3 oozes, how many oozes would there be after 5 strikes?
hint: After one strike there are 3, after two there are 9 — keep multiplying by 3 for each strike.
victory: Mr 6 sheathed his sword, announced that striking five times would summon 243 oozes, and instead pulled the drain plug — Gorrowpit swirled away with a very surprised gurgle.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight standing in knee-deep green mine water, sword pointedly sheathed, facing a wobbling glowing ooze that is already faintly splitting into three, lit by a single hanging lamp.
